name: Universal Tests Are Closed under Disjoint Boolean Substitution
statement: If $T\in\mathcal U_{X\sqcup\{i\}}$ and $S\in\mathcal U_Y$ on disjoint new coordinates, then $(T[i=0]\times S)\cup(T[i=1]\times S^{\mathrm c})$ is universal. Empty outputs use the source's constant-test convention.
proof: Substitute $T$ into an arbitrary represented outer class and then substitute $S$ into the surviving coordinate $i$. Universality preserves maximum-generatedness at each stage, and associativity of the set construction identifies the final class with substitution by the composite test.
